tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background: pure white (Light White mode).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Tables, inputs and panels on the page.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Cards and inset surfaces (Light Gray mode), derived-value wells.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card borders (#EAEAEA).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders (4.5:1 on white).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and primary text.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on white and #F4F4F4.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Icons, placeholder text and disabled labels only (3:1). Never for text that must be read.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Accent (pool): links, selection, focus, High band. Never purple.

tokens.name: signal-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of signal fills and links.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the Medium band chip, tinted grounds behind signal text.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal or signal-strong fill.

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: The evidence marker: the rule beside a quote and the underline of a highlighted span. Not for text.

tokens.name: marker-soft
tokens.usage: Highlight behind the exact words a claim rests on. Text on it stays ink.

tokens.name: verdict-confirmed
tokens.usage: Confirmed verdict fill; Likely verdict text and glyph on verdict-confirmed-soft.

tokens.name: verdict-confirmed-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Likely verdict badge.

tokens.name: on-verdict-confirmed
tokens.usage: Text on a verdict-confirmed fill.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Healthy state, Interested reply, verified contact point. As text, on paper, surface and positive-soft.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind positive text.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Warnings: bounce rate at 5 percent, Not now reply, risky contact point, review needed. As text, on paper, surface and caution-soft.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind caution text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Contradicted verdict, incidents, pushes paused, Unsubscribe, destructive actions. Orange, not red, so it never relies on red/green alone. As text, on paper, surface and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind danger text.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (destructive button).

tokens.name: band-medium
tokens.usage: Filled pips of the Medium band meter (3:1 on surface). Not for text.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Body copy: black at 70% (guidelines).

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Instrument Sans for everything a person operates. Dense by default: body is 14px.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen titles and the entity name on the account page. Once per screen.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Hiring two Revit technicians for the Rotterdam office.
styles.usage: Table cells, form text, running copy.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Found by the job-postings radar 3 days ago
styles.usage: Secondary lines under a primary value, helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase field labels and column headers. Always uppercase, always ink-muted.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: JetBrains Mono for identifiers, versions and numbers that line up. Always tabular.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Scores, counts, costs and versions inside tables and derived values.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Entity IDs, version stamps, external IDs, timestamps.

groups.name: Evidence
groups.note: Source Serif 4 is the voice of a source. Only quoted source text is set in it, so a reader can tell the platform's words from the evidence at a glance.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: We are looking for two BIM technicians fluent in Revit to join our Rotterdam team.
styles.usage: The text of an EvidenceQuote. Never for the platform's own copy.

spacing.note: 4px base. Dense screens use space-2 and space-3; panels breathe at space-4 and space-6.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, pip gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and compact controls; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; gap between related fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; the page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; between major regions.

radius.note: Instrument-precise: small radii, nothing round except status pips.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Highlights, pips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Tags, chips, badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Standard cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large cards, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Feature cards with a product-card gradient.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Primary buttons.

shadow.note: Borders carry structure; shadows only lift what floats.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest on paper.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Popovers, the Explain panel, menus, toasts, dialogs.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px surface gap, then a solid 2px signal ring.
